messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about HISTORY in Germany, England, Sweden, and United States of America during the 1950s and 1960s and 1970s and 1980s and 1990s and 2000s, matching this research need: Long-run comparative time-series data on violent crime and social integration, linking homicide, assault, imprisonment, inequality, unemployment, precarious work, welfare, family change, migration, and perceived security in Germany, Britain, and Sweden, 1950s-2000s
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.
